Agent governance is where identity security and AI risk converge, and most enterprises do not yet have the infrastructure to manage it. Every organization I have talked to is at a different stage: some are governing a handful of agents, some have hundreds operating across their environment without full visibility. results.title: Reco Expands Leadership Team and Global Operations as Enterprise AI Governance Demand Grows | citybiz
results.content:
Additional appointments include Dana Harduf as chief human resources officer, Sandy Mathews as vice president of product marketing and Merav Keren Kindler as vice president of marketing. [...] Reco, which provides an AI security platform focused on discovering, governing and securing AI agents, identities and SaaS connections, announced several leadership appointments alongside new operations in Texas and the United Kingdom and Ireland. The company said the moves reflect accelerating demand from large enterprises seeking governance infrastructure for AI deployments. [...] June 8, 2026

As enterprises deploy growing numbers of AI agents across business applications, security teams are facing a new challenge: maintaining visibility, governance and control over systems that increasingly operate autonomously. Reco is positioning itself to address that challenge with a series of executive hires, international expansion efforts and channel partnerships aimed at supporting what the company views as a rapidly emerging enterprise security category.
